<!-- pr-reviewer: 76f67cbb9bdd822918e44520d8c66fa3e8908499 -->
Needs changes before merge.

What looks good:

- The module uses plain input data. It adds no dependency on the post crate.
- The tests check closed shells, generated marks, joint order, pivots, offsets, and named refusals.
- The new modules state their sources. The decision file records the choices.

Results, locally trial-merged with upstream/main `acd5b02d3e36a12745b11038012240781129d43c`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS; 4 steps, including the build |
| sim library | 192 passed |
| `machine_model` | 5 passed |
| `machine_model_refusals` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| Both new suites after restoration | 12 passed |

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the PR adds geometry.

Mutations run by the reviewer, one at a time:

| Mutation | Pin | Mutated / restored |
|---|---|---|
| Remove the pivot translation | `a_rotary_turns_about_its_pivot_and_a_part_sits_at_its_offset` | FAIL / PASS |
| Use an inscribed cylinder instead of a circumscribed cylinder | `each_body_is_closed_and_marked_generated` | FAIL / PASS |

The pivot mutation produced this failure:

```text
cylinder of hed: axis 2 spans -80..30.000000000000007, want 320..430
```

The cylinder mutation produced this failure:

```text
body of head: volume 1170541.932096768, want 1181896.8402859708
```

All temporary edits were restored. No review evidence was committed.

Extra suites run: none. The PR changes no fixture, golden, testdata file, or importer. The extra selection rules do not apply.

Goldens: none moved. No NC or CL output changed. UI screenshots: not applicable; the PR changes no UI file.

Heavy lanes: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects the app and motion lanes. They were not run. This is not a pass.

Requested before merge:

1. [P2] `crates/sim/src/machine_model/mod.rs:317`: Handle spindle data on moving parts, or refuse that input by name. `PartSpec` permits a linear or rotary joint with spindle and tool-station dimensions. The input check accepts it. The match calls `head` only for a fixed joint. Thus a moving head loses its spindle and tool-envelope bodies. I reproduced both cases by changing the VMC head to a moving joint with a finite axis. Generation succeeded, but reported no body despite the stated dimensions. Add pins for these combinations. Do not omit the bodies from an accepted model.
2. [P2] `crates/sim/src/lib.rs:21`: Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Add the lane names and results to the PR body. The heavy plan selects app and motion because this crate entry changed. The body reports only the quick gate and clippy. Current upstream AGENTS.md, "Heavy lanes at review", requires the reached lanes before the PR is ready.

Notes:

- The trial merge is clean. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.
- The PR remains a draft because the review has blockers.
- The Cargo manifest warning about `truck-polymesh` is in current main. It did not fail these checks.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
